reason: Integrates Volcengine Ark Agent Plan and Coding Plan as external LLM providers for DeepSeek Harness, including model routing, API credential resolution, and reasoning-level configuration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入火山方舟 Agent Plan 和 Coding Plan 模型，并提供模型路由、凭据解析与思考强度配置。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Volcengine Ark Agent Plan and Coding Plan models with provider routing, credential resolution, and configurable reasoning levels.

capabilities: Registers Volcengine Ark Agent Plan and Coding Plan LLM providers
Routes model requests to external Volcengine Ark endpoints
Resolves API keys from DSH credentials and environment variables
Exposes model catalogs and configurable reasoning levels
